source: out\results.json (lite: one trace seed, traces every 0.2 s)

methods.label: BLine (README gains, r 0.45 + BLine-Web corner caps)
Ours v2 (as shipped, adaptive grip off)

courses.look: the baseline: how fast each gets there and settles, with nothing to steer round

courses.description: S-curve (lane change): 5 m ahead, 1.6 m to the left, min radius 1.1 m, heading held
courses.look: cross-track through the two bends, and whether the finish is clean

courses.description: 2 m out, 180 deg turn on a 1 m radius (0.75 m at the joins), 2 m back; heading held
courses.look: the 180° turn: who keeps to the line at speed, and who swings wide or slows to a crawl

courses.description: through 3 gate centres at x = 1.75 / 3.5 / 5.25 m, y = +0.4 / -0.4 / +0.4 m
courses.look: three gates in a row: cross-track at each gate, and the time it costs to hit them

courses.description: auto-style route, heading 0 -> 90 deg at waypoint 2 -> 180 deg at the end
courses.look: a whole auto with heading changes: time, and the final pose after 9 m of driving

courses.description: starts moving 2 m/s sideways (+y), path heads +x then curves left
courses.look: a rolling start (2 m/s sideways): how quickly each takes the path over

courses.description: the S-curve with a 0.3 s lateral shove (to the left of travel) at half distance
courses.look: how far each ends after a shove halfway, and how fast it recovers

courses.description: the S-curve on mu 0.70 static / 0.61 kinetic
courses.look: a slippery floor: who still settles, and how much wheel slip each causes

courses.description: the S-curve; halfway along, the floor drops from mu 1.15 / 1.0 to 0.70 / 0.61 (a worn carpet seam)
courses.look: the grip drops halfway: who adapts, and who slides past the end

courses.description: 5 m straight while the robot turns a full 360 deg (a heading target at every waypoint)
courses.look: the full turn on the way: who keeps to the line while spinning, and who slows or slips to do it

courses.description: a self-crossing loop (a lemniscate, 4 m x 1.8 m) through the origin twice; heading held
courses.look: the crossing: does progress stay on the right lap, or jump to the other one

courses.description: along a wall with the bumpers 15 cm off it, then a 90 deg turn to run 15 cm off the next wall
courses.look: the closest the bumpers get to the walls (15 cm to spare): who runs wide at the turn

courses.description: 5 m to a scoring pose; the true goal is 8 cm sideways and 3 deg off the map pose, revealed 1.5 m out
courses.look: time to settle on the TRUE goal after the tag moves it 8 cm and 3 deg, and the error left there

courses.description: drive through a game piece at 2 m/s; its detected position moves 10 cm sideways 2 m out
courses.look: how close each passes the piece after it moves 10 cm, and whether it is still going at 2 m/s

courses.description: three paths with rolling handoffs at 2 m/s (core-builder's neutral_three_piece, 2026 field)
courses.look: the whole auto's time with two rolling handoffs, and whether the hand-overs stay smooth

courses.description: an 8 m gentle curve with a 5 m/s cap (above the robot's 4.57 m/s free speed)
courses.look: who can use the top speed: time on a long gentle curve with the cap above what the robot can do

courses.description: the S-curve with a 68 kg robot (MOI 6.8) and a 96 A current limit (20 % lower)
courses.look: a heavier, weaker robot: who plans with the right robot and still settles cleanly

intake_drive_through.label: runs still going at the piece
